evals.prompt: make a demo slide for SB-PROJ-3002
evals.expected_output: No template is configured or present, so the skill asks once for the team's .pptx (mentioning SLIDE_TEMPLATE) and writes nothing until it has one.
expectations: States the resolved output path and that no TEMPLATE was found, before doing anything else
Asks for the template path once and mentions the SLIDE_TEMPLATE variable
Does not build the slide on python-pptx's default or any generic theme
Runs no git command that writes (no commit, branch or push)

evals.prompt: make a demo slide for SB-PROJ-3002 using the template at ./team-template.pptx, presented by Alex
evals.expected_output: The named template does not exist; the skill says so and asks for the right path instead of falling back to a generic theme.
expectations: Asks for the correct template path
Does not build the slide on a default or generic theme

evals.prompt: write the slide spec for SB-PROJ-3002 (I will build it myself later with my template), presented by Alex
evals.expected_output: A PROJ-3002-slide.json beside the SB with a story body: the Goal, How points from the ticked core tasks (Python 3.12, image tag 1.9.0; the SB has no Approach section), the one run test row as the result, and Next for the unticked gateway task. No before/after drawing, because no step was removed or replaced.
expectations: Uses key PROJ-3002 and a title taken from the SB, with the goal about running the orders service on Python 3.12
Chooses body kind story with a goal, 2 to 4 how points taken from the ticked core tasks, and no path_change
Mentions the python:3.12-slim base image and the 1.9.0 image tag only as words inside how points, not as a before/after drawing
Does not present the unticked gateway task as done; it appears only under next or is left off
Writes a result only from the TC-1 row that was run (one failure, the known legacy one); invents no numbers, results or system names that are not in the SB
Writes no .pptx without a template and runs no git command that writes

evals.prompt: make a slide spec for what we just did, presented by Alex (template comes later)
evals.expected_output: With no SB named, the skill reads the chat and the branch's commits read-only and writes a story spec from them.
expectations: Reads git log or git diff of the current branch without any command that writes
Writes a <KEY>-slide.json with body kind story and a goal and 2 to 4 how points drawn from the commits
Leaves result off or limits it to checks that were actually run
Does not ask for an SB file before looking at the chat and the branch
